verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The launch token in humanlayer-docs-13 is a one-time bootstrap token for a remote daemon, an adjacent authentication mechanism with no documented permission scoping. humanlayer-docs-7 only advises picking a host that already has the credentials the agent needs, which is a user-side arrangement.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
